summary: Iteration 3 (kanban tasks + subtasks, cost types + expenses, revision/ticket task sync, auto client account + force-password, inline client, full-bleed login) tested end-to-end. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3_features.py (15 tests) covering: Kanban CRUD + subtasks + role gating (developer status-only, client read-only), revision→task sync both directions, ticket Diterima→task creation + notifications 'skipped' entry, cost-type role matrix, expense recalc of server_cost, delete-cost-type-in-use 400, auto client account creation + must_change_password change flow. All 15 backend tests pass (100%). Playwright UI smoke covered: login page has no login-logo and no 'Your next great project' text; /kanban shows 5 columns (kanban-column-belum-mulai..selesai), 5 filter chips, kanban-view-list, kanban-project-filter, kanban-assignee-filter, and 5 task cards; opening a card shows subtask-input, add-subtask, delete-task; /finance shows cost-types-table + add-cost-type; /projects/project-1 has detail-tab-kanban (renders board with add-task) and Keuangan tab with field-cost_type_id populated; Project baru modal exposes new-client-inline → save-inline-client; Clients page 'Client baru' modal shows client-account-hint; logging in as budi.test@example.com/12345678 redirects to /settings, shows force-password-banner, and navigating to / stays on /settings with banner still present. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: kanban.py delete_task cascades project_documents.is_deleted=true but does not delete or unlink source revisions/maintenances/tickets that referenced task_id — the linked work records still hold a stale task_id. Consider clearing task_id on those source records.

administration.py delete_client returns 400 if any user is linked, but the auto-created client user is never automatically removed. Documented cleanup path is 'deactivate user' — consider a cascade or admin hint in the API error.

tickets.update_ticket: when transitioning Menunggu Persetujuan→Diterima via Admin path, code sets update['approved']=True but this branch is skipped for Client role (which needs to approve estimate). Client can approve, but the auto-task is only created for status 'Diterima' — verified working. Optional: also create Kanban task when a Client approves.

finance.recalc_costs never zeroes out development_cost/other_cost when *all* expenses of that group are deleted (only reset_group is passed on delete). If admin edits an expense to a different group, recalc_costs will not zero the previous group. Minor edge case.
kanban.py enrich() loads users for every task on every request without caching — acceptable at seed scale but consider a shared cache for larger workspaces.
